name: stats
js: (() => { const C = window.CITY, s = C.patioStats; const q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('patios'); const out = { season: s.season, layout: s.layout, fingerprint: s.fingerprint, check: s.check, placed: s.placed, accepted: s.accepted, rejected: s.rejected, blockers: s.blockers, instances: s.instances, laneConflicts: s.laneConflicts && s.laneConflicts.length, ms: s.ms, q: location.search }; console.log('[ride-check] patios ' + JSON.stringify(out)); if (q !== '0') { if (!s.season || s.placed.curb < 80 || s.placed.sidewalk < 40) throw new Error('CafeTO patios missing'); if (s.laneConflicts && s.laneConflicts.length) throw new Error('Curb lane platform in a traffic lane: ' + JSON.stringify(s.laneConflicts.slice(0, 5))); if (!s.fingerprint || !s.fingerprint.ok) throw new Error('The prebuilt patio layout is stale (rebuild: tools/build-patios.mjs): ' + JSON.stringify(s.fingerprint)); if (q === 'check' && !(s.check && s.check.identical)) throw new Error('The prebuilt patio layout is not the runtime algorithm\'s: ' + JSON.stringify(s.check)); if (!q && s.layout !== 'prebuilt') throw new Error('Patios laid out at startup: ' + s.layout); } return out; })()

name: ossington-146-curb-aerial
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP; app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-2971.6, 11, -1134.3], look: [-2984.6, 0.5, -1143.3], fov: 50 }); const s = window.CITY.patioStats.sites.find((p) => p.address === "146 OSSINGTON AVE" && p.kind === "curb"); console.log('[ride-check] ossington-146-curb ' + JSON.stringify(s ? { id: s.id, kind: s.kind, x: +s.cx.toFixed(1), z: +s.cz.toFixed(1), length: s.length, depth: +s.depth.toFixed(2) } : 'not placed in the browser')); })()
